seed: The placement contract at the top of UX-PATTERNS.md, on the running app at Next defaults: every area of the window has one purpose. A recording in View and in Edit, and a picture in Edit and in View, each photographed so every control can be read against the row that owns it. The tool bar holds tools and the colour pair only, with the grid switched on too: the grid is a way of looking, so it is the View menu's, and its cell size is a row in Grid Settings rather than a button on the bar.

steps.note: a recording just opened: View. Title bar (name, View | Edit), the picture, the transport. Nothing else
Edit: title bar, tool bar (tools only), inspector, transport (playback only), timeline (time and tracks)
a picture: title bar, tool bar, inspector
a tool that paints brings the colour pair, the one thing on the bar that is not itself a tool
the grid is drawn and the bar is unchanged: the grid is the View menu's
View > Grid Settings rises out of the bar and carries the cell size as a row
a picture in View: the window-level mode, set from the title bar or Cmd 1
